newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine thief strangled in all-you-can-eat heist.
newsitem.headline: Argentine thief strangled in all-you-can-eat heist.

text.p: An Argentine cook and a waiter chased a thief who held up their all-you-can-eat steak house with a toy gun and strangled him to death, a newspaper reported on Sunday.

Claudio Bruni, 24, threatened staff on Friday at the El Parador steakhouse in central Buenos Aires with what later turned out to be a plastic imitation of a 38 calibre revolver and made off with $200, the Clarin daily reported.
But when Bruni made off on foot, a waiter and a cook chased after him for several blocks until he bumped into a passer-by, fell over and was caught.
Police said that Bruni was kicked and his head beaten against the pavement until he was strangled to death.
The waiter and the cook were arrested.
